paragraphs.source_en: “Anyway, they had a row about whether I was Stan or not. It was a bit pathetic to be honest, but there were still five of them and only one of me, and they'd taken my wand. Then two of them got into a fight and while the others were distracted I managed to hit the one holding me in the stomach, grabbed his wand, Disarmed the bloke holding mine, and Disapparated. I didn't do it so well. Splinched myself again” -- Ron held up his right hand to show two missing fingernails: Hermione raised her eyebrows coldly -- “and I came out miles from where you were. By the time I got back to that bit of riverbank where we'd been ... you were gone.”
